description: Record declaring a review (rating and optional comment) of a recipe. One review per user per recipe.

main.description: Record key is the recipe's rkey for one-review-per-user-per-recipe; pass recipeId as rkey

comment.description: Optional review comment in GitHub-flavored markdown

rating.description: Star rating as integer 1-5 (1=1 star, 5=5 stars)

subject.description: Reference to the recipe being reviewed

updatedAt.description: When this review was last updated
